name: s5.globalAssignment
candidate: Apply the pinned exact one-to-one tee↔badge matcher to only fresh S5 two-ray badge-plate hits; preserve scored alternatives and unmatched S1 badges. When selected, S6 and S7 consume only resolved hit identities.
expectedBenefit: Resolve badge collisions with global cardinality and distance optimization while leaving impossible coverage and physical acceptance explicit.
falsifier: A selected pair lacks an original ray hit, duplicate tee/badge ownership survives, a shorter feasible augmenting assignment loses without disclosed scoring reason, or missing S1 badges are silently called complete.
